verdict: Close to break-even: at 2R the target has to come first in 33 % of the replays that hit one side; it did in 32 % (target first 28.4 % vs stop first 61.2 %).
note: A simulation built from IBM's own last 59 full sessions. It is not a prediction: earnings, news and halts can do things those sessions never did. Same seed, same numbers.
